history.content: Hi, my phone can't get any signal at all. I can't make calls or use the internet.

I can help you troubleshoot your signal issue. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status is currently active, so let's proceed with troubleshooting your signal issue.

To start, could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- "No Signal" or a signal strength indicator (bars)
- Any other unusual icons

This will help determine if the issue is related to your device settings or something else. If you need guidance on how to check, let me know your phone model (Android or iPhone), and I can assist you.
At the top of my phone it says 'No Signal' and 'Data Disabled', but I also see 'Connected to Chestnut-5G'. There are no signal bars and airplane mode isn't on.

Thank you for the details. Here’s what your status indicates:
- “No Signal” means your phone isn’t connecting to the cellular network.
- “Data Disabled” means mobile data is off.
- “Connected to Chestnut-5G” means you’re on Wi-Fi, but that won’t help with calls or texts.

Let’s try the following steps to restore your cellular signal:

1. Reseat your SIM card (this can often fix recognition issues).
2. Enable mobile data (so you can use the internet when not on Wi-Fi).

I’ll guide you through reseating your SIM card first. Please proceed to reseat your SIM card now. Let me know once you’ve done this, or if you need instructions.
I reseated the SIM card, but my phone says the SIM is still locked. The signal issue hasn't changed.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your phone says the SIM is locked, this is likely the cause of your signal issue. Unlocking a SIM that is locked due to incorrect PIN or PUK entries requires specialized support.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can assist you further with unlocking your SIM card.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
